rules: Build one bounded task slice per automation run.
Prefer local file-backed or SQLite-backed implementation before SaaS assumptions.
Do not require hosted auth, billing, dashboards, or live connector credentials for the OSS MVP.
Use fixture-based tests and dry-run modes for risky actions.
Extend existing Kai runtime, agent, quality, and gateway modules instead of creating parallel systems.
Do not revert unrelated user work.

tasks.name: Agent Registry
tasks.acceptance_summary: Local agent profile registry exists, supports create/list/get/revoke/check_scope, and has fixture tests.

tasks.name: Mandate Ledger
tasks.acceptance_summary: Structured local mandates exist and selected high-risk actions require valid mandates before execution.

tasks.name: Workflow SKU Manifests
tasks.acceptance_summary: At least five valid workflow SKU manifests exist and a loader validates required fields.

tasks.name: Connector Health Gate
tasks.acceptance_summary: Execution can be blocked or warned based on local connector health states with fixture tests.

tasks.name: Scheduled Handler Registration
tasks.acceptance_summary: Every default scheduled task resolves to a registered handler or fails loudly in validation.

tasks.name: Local Lead OS Package
tasks.acceptance_summary: Local Lead OS has docs, a workflow manifest, sample outputs, fixture data, and KaiCalls phone capture guidance.

tasks.name: Agentic Commerce Readiness Audit
tasks.acceptance_summary: Fixture-friendly commerce readiness audit scores catalog, checkout, offer, policy, and AI crawler gaps.

tasks.name: AI Referral Attribution
tasks.acceptance_summary: AI, creator, affiliate, shopping, form, and call source classes are normalized with fixture tests.

tasks.name: Evidence Pack Exporter
tasks.acceptance_summary: Markdown and JSON evidence packs export run metadata, claims, gates, approvals, mandates, connector health, and action results.

tasks.name: Creator Commerce Ops
tasks.acceptance_summary: Creator commerce audit and playbook cover fit, audience quality, rates, rights, disclosure, affiliate setup, GMV, and reuse.

tasks.name: Micropayment Monetization Playbook
tasks.acceptance_summary: Standalone GitHub docs cover pay-per-crawl, x402, paid APIs, paid MCP tools, content licensing, pricing tests, and risks.

tasks.name: Agentic Security Evals
tasks.acceptance_summary: Local evals cover prompt injection, tool poisoning, fake sources, mandate bypass, spend cap bypass, connector degradation, and cross-client leakage.
